summary: Iteration 618 backend+frontend tests: (1) GET /api/certifications/guide returns 8-item checklist with correct shape; (2) POST /api/accounting/mapping/qbo/aldgate-flats persists revenue='81' and drops unknown fields, verified via GET connectors; (3) Frontend AdminPanel 'Canlıya Geçiş' tab shows certification-guide, cert-progress '2/8 · %25', cert-toggle-gbp expands with ol steps + 'Başvuru sayfası' apply link; (4) Team Members prop-roles popover: pid+role selection produces preview 'etkin rol → viewer', Ekle saves with toast 'Tesis rolleri kaydedildi' and creates prop-role-row-*; (5) AccountingConnectorsCard MappingEditor: changing acct-map-xero-payments shows acct-map-save-xero, save produces toast 'Hesap eşlemesi kaydedildi'. Language switch partially works — FAB pill toggles (Report Issue → Ariza Bildir) but ApprovalQueuePanel and sidebar nav titles remained in EN when TR was selected (i18n not fully reactive across those panels in same session).

integration_issues.flow: Language selector (fab-pill-lang-tr / fab-pill-lang-en) — Approval Center title and bulk button
integration_issues.issue: After clicking fab-pill-lang-tr, Approval Center header still renders EN 'Approval Center' and 'Approve safe ones in bulk...' — sidebar nav items also remain in English while the FAB Report Issue button correctly switches to 'Ariza Bildir'. Suggests some components (ApprovalQueuePanel, menuSections consumer, AnalyticsPanel sentiment cards) are not re-rendering on language change or use a separate/stale i18n hook. i18n keys (ro.approval_center, ro.bulk_safe, ro.root_cause, nav.approvals) ARE present in both tr.json and en.json.

action_items: Investigate language reactivity: ApprovalQueuePanel/AnalyticsPanel/menu titles do not re-render immediately when fab-pill-lang-tr is toggled (verify LanguageSelector broadcasts change and consumers subscribe correctly, or force full-page re-render). Note FAB 'Report Issue' does switch correctly, so i18n context is loaded — issue is likely component-level subscription.
critical_code_review_comments: certification_guide.py: 'accounting' item computes done as OR of xero/qbo/efatura which is correct; consider also including CLIENT_SECRET presence check for completeness.
accounting_sync.py save_mapping: correctly filters keys via DEFAULT_MAPPING allowlist; upsert path creates connection with status='mapping_only' — good defensive design.
AccountingConnectorsCard MappingEditor: no debounce; on rapid typing might trigger multiple state updates, but functionally fine.
seed_data_creation: Test wrote QBO mapping {revenue:'81'} to aldgate-flats (accounting_connections) and Xero mapping payments='999' to default property. Also added prop_roles entry for admin user Hotel Admin on 'default' property with role viewer.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints for iteration 618 fully verified: /api/certifications/guide (8 items, correct shape), /api/accounting/mapping/{provider}/{pid} (filters unknown keys, persists to accounting_connections). Frontend all 4 scenarios (CertGuide, PropertyRoleEditor, Mapping save, i18n) exercised. i18n note: language switch works for FAB but Approval/Analytics panels appear unresponsive to same-session language toggle — verify LanguageSelector wiring.
